review: A restoration table is an open setting variation, realized completely in restoration-bench. It shifts the bench’s purpose toward restoration; the chosen B02-clarity keeps immediate controlled testing as the clearer reason for her attention.

The complete source describes a curved wood grip under one short barrel and an external flint-gripping lock beside it, conditions={}, effects appearance/material. B02-clarity retains these common period-pistol properties to strengthen the independent pistol silhouette: "Its curved walnut grip sits below one short barrel; the external flint-gripping lock is visibly attached beside that barrel." This is H-F2 material inspiration, not a qualified native whole-source selection. One barrel was already the baseline’s singular barrel; face/hair properties and the full source relation/count remain preserved.

The complete source is a displayed wheellock pistol, including its external wheel below the barrel and beside the stock. Its subject effect and ignition system cannot be silently narrowed to our flintlock lock. A second wheel-lock specimen adds a competing apparatus with no benefit to this c1 test scene; no partial wheel adoption.

The full embedding body includes revolver cylinder, pistol slide, rifle receiver and shotgun arrangements in a reference still life. Those complete modern structural families do not clarify our single period flintlock and its magical test; subject is locked. No generic firearm label can hide those source details.

Requires primary punk_dieselpunk context and a complete aircraft-engine/bearing/belt/oil-cart/service-tag handoff. That primary context is absent, and the equipment chain is not the drawn flintlock test.

Requires an eligible primary artifact/object/material tag; our actual primary subject is a human portrait, with no independently frozen primary artifact fact. The complete source’s bounded shallow recess field cannot be reduced to a vague engraved-magic decoration.

This is a cooking pan containing food or sauce and a flame envelope above those same contents. The priming pan is not that cooking owner. Retain the actual flintlock pan rather than transfer a flame/food graph by homonym.

The complete contextual relation names an established adult professional and requires every actor/tool/place outside change scope already established. No adult fact is frozen; do not retrofit it. Independently authored baseline already says "a horizontal waist-up frame with both forearms, the full pistol and the bottle legible"; retain that baseline geometry without attributing new authority to this source.

Requires an existing miniature artifact with small structural features and an existing familiar-size reference at the same depth. The bottled fictional storm was not frozen as a miniature artifact or calibrated scale model. A shared focus plane is independently in the baseline, not permission to replace these source owners.

Requires primary character_signature_object_scene_atomic_scene. That signature-prop character-bond context is not declared. A weather bench phrase alone cannot establish it, and departure would add a separate story premise.

The full source is an active leather artisan scene with grain, saddle clamp, paired needles, edge-finishing tools and an unfinished join. It cannot be used as a generic workbench without those parts. That leather-making event competes with the lock–storm test; it is a different task rather than a beneficial local refinement.

A watchmaker bench with tiny gears, lens and brass dust is realized completely in restoration-bench. It enriches the material surface but fills valuable foreground pixels with a second mechanical vocabulary; B02-clarity gives the flintlock itself those pixels.
Requires forensic context in addition to human applicability. The fictional craft test has no forensic evidence purpose; inspection alone does not witness that requirement.

Requires distinct fragments in a water/sediment sample, a relevant size reference and coherent carrier. The cloud’s small sparks are neither plastic fragments nor such a sample. No material/chemical inference from bright specks.

The complete flaying proposal separates a skin-like layer from a fictional body surface; its body_geometry effect is outside our open dimensions and it changes the photograph’s physical proposition. Reference facial appearance remains protected; no damage motif is borrowed.

The full relation is adult fashion against a labyrinth-like set, not merely a dark room contrast. No adult fact or fashion-set premise is frozen; importing a maze would substitute environmental spectacle for the bench relation.

The complete source describes an established adult moving an arm so material costume elements meet, with outside-scope scene elements already established. We have no adult witness or sound-costume system; actual sound cannot be proved by still pixels.

Complete compartmented seed box requires distinct seeds and a legible accession label on each compartment. Its text effect is not an open dimension, and the source cannot be reduced to an unlabeled workshop box.

Exactly three shaped cams on one shaft, each with a separate contacting follower, are a complete different apparatus. Its subject effect is not open; treating generic lockwork as that three-output cam stack would lose actual counts and contacts.

Requires adult context plus AB12 wristband and AB21 chart text simultaneously legible. Neither adult fact nor age/text changes are open. It is a medical-code mismatch, not a workshop inspection equivalent.

The SCP-scoped source requires an open printed book, wet ink beside printed area, and a separate external ink vessel. Its text effect is outside scope and its owners are not the bottled storm and lock. No history-changing claim from stains.

The source requires one creature with distinct appendages traceable to the same body and separate object-surface contacts. Its body_geometry effect is closed. Two human forearms in our own staging do not license importing its fictional anatomy contract.

The complete window-frame/opposite-facade reflection/interior-table transmission relation is realized in window-interface. It adds a visible glass interface and exterior facade; the competing reflection obscures the face and small lock more easily than B02-clarity’s direct view. It is not transferable to arbitrary bottle glints.

The small weather lab includes storm-glass vials, barometers and brass instruments, realized completely in weather-lab. It gives a plausible weather-study context but adds passive instrument density and shifts the strong period craft relation toward laboratory display; choose the plainer powderhouse setting.

This full profile requires a horizontal Korean bridge zither, multiple anjok bridges, right plucking/left pressing on opposite bridge sides, seated support and geomungo confound control. It is incompatible with the actual pistol/bottle hand task; no one gesture or bridge word is borrowed.

The complete ring-high-above-storm/centered-over-region/distinct-vertical-gap relation is realized in ring-in-bottle as a fictional miniature effect. It consumes the bottle’s limited projected height and reads less immediately than one lightning fork touching inner glass. Do not claim ELVES physics or causation at miniature scale.

The Hodegetria profile requires a represented Virgin and child, left-arm support, right-hand pointing toward that same child and explicit ownership. It is iconography with separate represented owners, not our one craftsperson’s bottle support. No inferred religious identity or borrowed hand layout.
